f.title: Observe Directive Articles 8(3), 9, 11 and 12 in an MA application
f.statement: When applying for a marketing authorisation for a medicinal product (other than a herbal medicinal product under Art. 42(8) of the Medicines Act), the applicant shall observe Articles 8(3), 9, 11 and 12 of Directive 2001/83/EC, which include the pharmacovigilance system summary and the risk management plan in the application dossier.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel B (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 3.7)
f.exceptions: Herbal medicinal products under Geneesmiddelenwet art. 42(8).

rows.quote: Bij de aanvraag van een vergunning voor het in de handel brengen van een geneesmiddel, niet zijnde een kruidengeneesmiddel als bedoeld in artikel 42, achtste lid, van de wet neemt de aanvrager de artikelen 8, derde lid, 9, 11 en 12 van richtlijn 2001/83 in acht.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel B (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 3.7)
rows.review_note: Review: the PV relevance (PV system summary and RMP in Art. 8(3)) is stated from the Directive the text cites. Double-check: statement's gloss on Art. 8(3) content is outside the quote, so 88.
rows.quote_en: When applying for an authorisation to place a medicinal product on the market, other than a herbal medicinal product as referred to in Article 42(8) of the Act, the applicant shall observe Articles 8(3), 9, 11 and 12 of Directive 2001/83.

f.title: Incorporate imposed MA conditions into the risk management system; may comment before they become final
f.statement: Where the Medicines Evaluation Board attaches a condition to the marketing authorisation (Directive Art. 21a or 22a), the MAH has the right under Art. 22a(2) of Directive 2001/83/EC (to request an opportunity to submit written observations) and shall observe Art. 22c(1) of that Directive (incorporating the condition in its risk management system).
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel D (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 3.16a, tweede lid)

rows.quote:
Indien een voorschrift als bedoeld in het eerste lid aan de handelsvergunning wordt verbon-
den, beschikt de houder van de handelsvergunning over het recht, bedoeld in artikel 22bis, tweede lid, van richtlijn 2001/83, en neemt hij artikel 22quater, eerste lid, van die richtlijn in acht.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel D (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 3.16a, tweede lid)
rows.review_note: Review: content of Directive Art. 22a(2)/22c(1) summarised from the explanatory note (Toelichting, art. 3.16a). Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees; gloss outside quote, so 88.
rows.quote_en: Where a condition as referred to in the first paragraph is attached to the marketing authorisation, the marketing authorisation holder shall have the right referred to in Article 22a(2) of Directive 2001/83, and shall observe Article 22c(1) of that Directive.

f.title: May comment when the CBG imposes a risk management system on an existing MA
f.statement: When the Medicines Evaluation Board uses its powers under Articles 104(4) and 104a(2) of Directive 2001/83/EC (for example to oblige the MAH to operate a risk management system), the MAH has the right referred to in Article 104a(3) of that Directive (to request an opportunity to submit written observations).
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.1)

rows.quote: De houder van de handelsvergunning beschikt daarbij over het recht, bedoeld in artikel 104bis, derde lid, van die richtlijn.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.1)
rows.review_note: Review: right only (Permitted); its content is taken from the Directive article cited. Double-check: gloss outside quote, so 85.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall have, in that connection, the right referred to in Article 104a(3) of that Directive.

f.title: Perform MAH pharmacovigilance tasks in line with Directive Article 104(2) and (3)
f.statement: In performing its pharmacovigilance tasks, the MAH shall observe Article 104(2) and (3) of Directive 2001/83/EC (operate a pharmacovigilance system; have a QPPV; maintain and make available a PSMF; operate a risk management system per product; monitor risk minimisation outcomes; update the RMS and monitor PV data). The qualified person appointed by the MAH is responsible for implementation (explanatory note).
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.2)
f.legal_basis: Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.2; Geneesmiddelenwet art. 76a(2); DIR Art 104(2)-(3)
f.processes: Safety governance; PSMF management; Risk management & minimisation

rows.quote:
De houder van de handelsvergunning neemt bij de uitoefening van zijn geneesmiddelenbewa-
kingstaken de artikelen 104, tweede en derde lid, van richtlijn 2001/83 in acht.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.2)
rows.review_note: Review: the list of Art. 104(3) duties is a gloss from the Directive the text cites. Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees; gloss outside quote, so 88.
rows.quote_en: In the exercise of its pharmacovigilance tasks, the marketing authorisation holder shall observe Article 104(2) and (3) of Directive 2001/83.

f.title: Per-product risk management system not required for MAs granted before 21 July 2012
f.statement: Without prejudice to Articles 8.1 and 8.2, Article 104(3)(c) of Directive 2001/83/EC (operate a risk management system for each product) does not apply to marketing authorisations granted before 21 July 2012.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.3)
f.exceptions: The CBG may still impose a risk management system under Art. 8.1 / Directive Art. 104a.

rows.quote: Onverminderd het bepaalde in artikelen 8.1 en 8.2, is artikel 104, derde lid, onderdeel c, van richtlijn 2001/83 niet van toepassing op handelsvergunningen die vóór 21 juli 2012 zijn verleend.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.3)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; 'neemt ... in acht' (shall observe) in a ministerial regulation states a binding duty (Mandatory); the cross-referenced Directive articles are named, not restated beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Without prejudice to Articles 8.1 and 8.2, Article 104(3)(c) of Directive 2001/83 shall not apply to marketing authorisations granted before 21 July 2012.

f.title: Observe Directive Article 106a for public PV communications
f.statement: When making public announcements based on pharmacovigilance data about risks in the use of medicinal products, the MAH shall observe Article 106a of Directive 2001/83/EC (inform the competent authorities, EMA and Commission in advance, and present the information objectively and not misleadingly).
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.5, eerste lid)
f.legal_basis: Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.5(1); Geneesmiddelenwet art. 77a; DIR Art 106a

rows.quote: De houder van de handelsvergunning neemt bij het doen van openbare mededelingen op basis van geneesmiddelenbewakingsgegevens over risico's in het gebruik van geneesmiddelen artikel 106bis van richtlijn 2001/83 in acht.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.5, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: content of Directive Art. 106a is a gloss. Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees; gloss outside quote, so 88.
rows.quote_en: When making public announcements based on pharmacovigilance data about risks in the use of medicinal products, the marketing authorisation holder shall observe Article 106a of Directive 2001/83.

f.title: Omit commercially confidential information from public PV communications unless public health requires it
f.statement: Publication of public announcements based on pharmacovigilance data shall always omit commercially confidential information, unless protection of public health precludes this.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.5, tweede lid)
f.exceptions: Unless protection of public health precludes omission.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (publisher of the announcement)
rows.quote:
Openbaarmaking van mededelingen als bedoeld in het eerste lid geschiedt steeds met weglating van commercieel vertrouwelijke informatie, tenzij de bescherming van de volksge-
zondheid daaraan in de weg staat.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.5, tweede lid)
rows.review_note: Review: provision is impersonal; applies to announcements by the MAH under paragraph 1. Double-check: actor inferred, so 85.
rows.quote_en: Publication of announcements as referred to in the first paragraph shall always take place with the omission of commercially confidential information, unless the protection of public health precludes this.

f.title: Record and report suspected adverse reactions in line with Directive Article 107
f.statement: In recording and reporting suspected adverse reactions, the MAH shall observe Article 107 of Directive 2001/83/EC (record all suspected ADRs; report serious cases to EudraVigilance within 15 days and non-serious EU cases within 90 days; literature monitoring; follow-up; duplicate detection).
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.6, eerste lid)
f.legal_basis: Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.6(1); Geneesmiddelenwet art. 78(1); DIR Art 107

rows.quote: De houder van de handelsvergunning neemt bij de registratie en melding van vermoedelijke bijwerkingen artikel 107 van richtlijn 2001/83 in acht.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.6, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: content of Directive Art. 107 (15/90-day timelines etc.) is a gloss, confirmed in the explanatory note; no deadline_rule because the deadlines are not stated in the operative text. Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees; 88.
rows.quote_en: In recording and reporting suspected adverse reactions, the marketing authorisation holder shall observe Article 107 of Directive 2001/83.

f.title: Submit PSURs electronically to EMA per Directive Article 107b; follow 107g(2) outcomes
f.statement: The MAH shall submit periodic safety update reports electronically to the European Medicines Agency in accordance with Article 107b of Directive 2001/83/EC and shall observe Article 107g(2) (apply for a variation with updated SmPC and leaflet following a single PSUR assessment where required). The MAH has the right referred to in Article 107c(6) (to request harmonisation of PSUR frequency/EU reference date). The CBG sets the PSUR frequency in the MA.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.7, eerste lid)
f.processes: Aggregate reporting; Submission operations; Safety labeling

rows.quote: De houder van de handelsvergunning dient elektronisch periodieke veiligheidsverslagen in bij het Bureau overeenkomstig artikel 107ter van richtlijn 2001/83. Hij neemt daarbij artikel 107octies, tweede lid, van die richtlijn in acht. De houder van de handelsvergunning beschikt over het recht, bedoeld in artikel 107quater, zesde lid van die richtlijn.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.7, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: content of the Directive articles cited is a gloss (also explained in the Toelichting). Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees; 88.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder shall submit periodic safety update reports electronically to the Agency in accordance with Article 107b of Directive 2001/83. In doing so it shall observe Article 107g(2) of that Directive. The marketing authorisation holder has the right referred to in Article 107c(6) of that Directive.

f.title: Older MAs and single-Member-State products: submit PSURs per Directive Article 107c(2)
f.statement: Where the MA was granted before 21 July 2012, or the product is authorised in only one Member State and Article 107c(4) does not apply, the MAH shall, by derogation from Art. 8.7(1), submit PSURs in accordance with Article 107c(2) of Directive 2001/83/EC (default frequency: on request, or six-monthly then yearly then three-yearly).
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.7, derde lid)
f.applicability: MAs granted before 21 July 2012; products authorised in only one Member State without an EU reference date

rows.quote: Indien een handelsvergunning vóór 21 juli 2012 is verleend of sprake is van een geneesmiddel dat slechts in één lidstaat is toegelaten en waarop artikel 107quater, vierde lid, van richtlijn 2001/83 niet van toepassing is, dient de houder van de handelsvergunning, in afwijking van het bepaalde in artikel 8.7, eerste lid, periodieke veiligheidsverslagen in overeenkomstig artikel 107quater, tweede lid, van die richtlijn.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.7, derde lid)
rows.review_note: Review: the default frequency is a gloss from Directive Art. 107c(2). Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees; 88.
rows.quote_en: Where a marketing authorisation was granted before 21 July 2012 or the medicinal product is authorised in only one Member State and Article 107c(4) of Directive 2001/83 does not apply to it, the marketing authorisation holder shall, by way of derogation from Article 8.7(1), submit periodic safety update reports in accordance with Article 107c(2) of that Directive.

f.title: Conduct non-interventional PASS in line with Directive Articles 107m(6)-(7) and 107n-107q
f.statement: In conducting non-interventional post-authorisation safety studies, the MAH shall act in accordance with Articles 107m(6) and (7) and 107n to 107q of Directive 2001/83/EC (protocol approval, amendments, final study report within 12 months of end of data collection, results). The CBG has the power in Art. 107m(5) to require protocols and progress reports.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.8, eerste lid)
f.legal_basis: Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.8(1); Geneesmiddelenwet art. 80(4); DIR Art 107m-107q

rows.quote: De houder van de handelsvergunning handelt bij de uitvoering van niet-interventionele 3 Staatscourant 2013 nr. 3803 15 februari 2013 veiligheidsstudies na toelating overeenkomstig artikelen 107quaterdecies, zesde en zevende lid, en 107quindecies tot en met 107octodecies van richtlijn 2001/83.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.8, eerste lid)
rows.review_note: Review: the quote includes the running page header that interrupts the sentence. Content of the Directive articles (protocol approval, final report) is a gloss. Double-check: bilingual re-translation agrees; gloss outside quote, so 88.
rows.quote_en: In conducting non-interventional [page header: 3 Staatscourant 2013 no. 3803, 15 February 2013] post-authorisation safety studies, the marketing authorisation holder shall act in accordance with Articles 107m(6) and (7) and 107n to 107q of Directive 2001/83.

f.title: Submit protocols of imposed non-interventional PASS run only in the Netherlands to the CCMO
f.statement: The Central Committee on Research Involving Human Subjects (CCMO) is responsible for assessing draft protocols of the non-interventional post-authorisation safety studies referred to in Article 107n of Directive 2001/83/EC that take place only in the Netherlands; the MAH therefore submits such protocols to the CCMO instead of PRAC.
f.clause: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.8, tweede lid)
f.legal_basis: Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.8(2); Geneesmiddelenwet art. 80(3); DIR Art 107n
f.applicability: Imposed non-interventional PASS conducted only in the Netherlands

rows.quote: De centrale commissie voor medisch-wetenschappelijk onderzoek, bedoeld in artikel 14 van de Wet medisch-wetenschappelijk onderzoek met mensen, is belast met de beoordeling van ontwerpprotocollen van niet-interventionele veiligheidsstudies na toelating als bedoeld in artikel 107quindecies van richtlijn 2001/83 die uitsluitend in Nederland plaatsvinden.
rows.location: Artikel I, onderdeel F (Regeling Geneesmiddelenwet art. 8.8, tweede lid)
rows.review_note: Review: national addition (CCMO instead of PRAC). The provision assigns the task to the CCMO; the MAH's submission duty follows from Directive Art. 107n and the explanatory note. Double-check: actor duty inferred, so 85.
rows.quote_en: The Central Committee on Research Involving Human Subjects referred to in Article 14 of the Medical Research Involving Human Subjects Act is responsible for assessing draft protocols of non-interventional post-authorisation safety studies as referred to in Article 107n of Directive 2001/83 that take place exclusively in the Netherlands.
